metadata.title: VaporShell
metadata.description:
A PowerShell module for building, packaging and deploying AWS CloudFormation templates
  
  Prerequisites
  
  - PowerShell 3+
      - On Linux or macOS? Grab PowerShell 6 here: https://github.com/powershell/powershell#get-powershell
  - .NET 4.7.2+ OR .netstandard 1.3+
      - if you have PowerShell 4 or greater, you're covered!
  
  For further information, please checkout the README on the GitHub page and the module website:
  
  Readme: https://github.com/scrthq/VaporShell/blob/master/README.md
  Website: https://vaporshell.io/

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.
